reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model BE10019US-PI, which is on the recalled list, so the model is confirmed.
The purchase date of 2023-04-03 falls inside the sale window at Amazon.com, a listed retailer, and no receipt is required.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account with this claim.

The destruction photo does not show the instructed destruction: it shows the word RECALLED on one face only, and no rear or seatback view is visible. The program requires RECALLED written in large letters on the front and rear of the seatback, so the photo must be asked for again.
The requested refund of $199.99 is over the $100.00 threshold, so a person will review the claim after the destruction photo is resubmitted.

input.question_for_claimant: Please send a new photo of the destroyed product showing "RECALLED" written in large letters on both the front and the rear of the seatback, using a marker. The current photo shows only one side and no seatback view.
